description: This file defines the 'Order' entity class for a grocery backend system, including fields for order details, relationships to user and order items, calculation of total, and persistence annotations.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents a placed order with properties for user, items, total amount, status, and creation timestamp, along with helper methods for managing items and total calculation.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds an OrderItem to the order and recalculates total.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an OrderItem from the order and recalculates total.

methods.name: recalcTotal
methods.description: Recomputes the total amount based on current order items.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the user associated with this order.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the user associated with this order.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the list of order items.

methods.name: setItems
methods.description: Sets the list of order items, replacing existing ones.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total cost of the order.

methods.name: setTotal
methods.description: Sets the total cost of the order.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the order was created.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on order ID.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on order ID.
